TextEng: Close relatives of the malevolent Will-o-Wisp, Saint Elmo's Fire is a sentient creature composed of gas and energy. They are often near swampy areas.
Talented illusionists and irreverent pranksters, Drixies make their homes in hollowed trees and rocky grottoes, deep within the forests.

Few tell of the fearling for few escape its grasp. These telepathic creatures are born from the corpses of the guilty and use their powers to project frightening images of their host's foul deeds into the minds of the living.

Upon his death, the Dark Ranger's animal companion fled into the swamp and started her own brood. Many generations have passed but the Horde Ravens remain and still remember their loyalty to the Dark Ranger's cause.
